thread:
marco-gomez: Shipping QuickStart Audit Export for on-prem / VPC installs today. This gives customers an easy way to export a tamper-evident audit bundle for compliance reviews (SOC2/HIPAA-ready metadata). Pilot first, GA after validation.

lina-zhou: Nice. What's included in the bundle?

marco-gomez: Bundle v1 contains: inventory manifest, installed package checksums, running service configs, network bindings, KMS/HSM integration summary (if configured), and a signed attestation statement. We also include an optional encrypted transfer to the customer's storage endpoint.

ops-bot: NOTE: rollout schedule: pilot release -> 1795000001, opt-in GA -> 1795086400 (one week). Regions: us-east-1, eu-central-1 first.

security-bot: Important: export requires admin consent from the customer's console and a verification of advertised IP ranges. The attestation is a signed statement included in the bundle; it is not a replacement for a full audit.

samira-rahman: CLI support? Many customers still prefer offline artifacts for air-gapped installs.

marco-gomez: Yes. CLI example for offline package:

```
rwctl export-audit --mode offline --out /tmp/rw-audit-$(date +%s).zip --license <LICENSE>
```

And for direct upload to S3-compatible storage:

```
rwctl export-audit --mode upload --dest s3://customer-bucket/redwood-audit --encrypt --license <LICENSE>
```

linA-zhou: (typo) Lina-zhou: We'll add a checksum validation helper to the installer in the next patch.

solutions-marketing: Can we get a 1-pager and a short deck for compliance teams? We can reuse some of the wording from the runbook.

marco-gomez: Will do. Tagging @solutions-marketing for copy. Also uploading the internal runbook to Confluence: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/onprem-audit-export (internal only).

sales-ops: How do we position this vs private deploy onboarding? Any gating?

marco-gomez: For pilots we require a Solutions Engineer kickoff and a signed attestation form. GA will be opt-in from Console with an Admin role grant. No hard gating beyond the license and admin confirmation for GA.

security-bot: Cryptography note: export bundles include metadata about KMS usage, but we do not ship private keys. If customers want an HSM audit proof, they must enable audit logging for their HSM and provide the logs; we include pointers in the bundle.

samira-rahman: Pilot customers get priority SE time (1hr walkthrough) and two-week onboarding support. Please add pilot names to the tracker.

ops-bot: Action: SEs - add interested accounts to the pilot tracker by 1795020000.

marco-gomez: Thank you. If you spot any gaps in the runbook or need a sample attestation PDF, ping me. :rocket:
